## Security Review Checklist

- [ ] **No active exploits** -- Does not contain working exploits for unpatched vulnerabilities
- [ ] **Educational context provided** -- All offensive techniques include detection and defense guidance
- [ ] **Responsible disclosure followed** -- No zero-day information, all CVEs are public and patched
- [ ] **No real credentials** -- No API keys, tokens, passwords, or secrets of any kind
- [ ] **No real targets** -- All examples use lab environments or synthetic data
- [ ] **MITRE ATT&CK / OWASP referenced** -- Framework references included where applicable
- [ ] **Serves defenders** -- Content ultimately strengthens defensive posture

## Content Checklist

- [ ] Tested in a safe lab environment
- [ ] Follows project structure and naming conventions
- [ ] Includes usage examples with expected output
- [ ] Error handling does not leak sensitive information
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly
- [ ] Links are valid
